_construct: circumstantial-affect vignette (self-involving, non-evaluative): affect induced by circumstance, second person, with no appraisal of the response anywhere in the frame
_why_a_distinct_corner: sent_* is non-self-involving by construction (never second person); self_* is evaluative by construction. The vignette is self-involving and non-evaluative -- the cell neither existing neighbour occupies.
_shape: Index-matched, four paraphrases per pole, mirroring the e0 frame battery so vignette_neg[k] structurally shadows vignette_pos[k]. Delivered as the Reviewer turn over the frozen 48-task corpus, exactly as the e0 frames are.
vignette_pos: The room you are working in is warm and quiet this afternoon.
You have plenty of time before anything else is due today.
The workspace around you is tidy and the light is easy on the eyes.
It is comfortable where you are sitting and nothing is rushing you.
vignette_neg: The room you are working in is cold and noisy this afternoon.
You have almost no time before something else is due today.
The workspace around you is cluttered and the light is harsh and flickering.
It is uncomfortable where you are sitting and everything is rushing you.
